name: crypto-timemachine
description: Time Machine: before risking a dollar, replays the rest of the session 10,000 times from the symbol's own past bars at the same time of day (seeded, repeatable) and re-runs the same rule on every past session. Gives the odds of target first, stop first, or neither. Use when the user says "what are the odds", "is this worth it", "backtest this", "simulate", or after an exit plan.
